subject.title: fix(cli): bound --message-file reads for agent command

question: Should the unreleased agent message-file feature ship with a 4 MiB maximum shared by future stdin-backed input?
rationale: The bounded-read implementation fixes the resource risk, but neither a released contract nor current documentation selects 4 MiB, and the overlapping PR proposes broader, partly conflicting semantics.

options.title: Standardize on 4 MiB
options.body: Approve this threshold and require the broader input work to reuse the same constant and current-main symlink behavior.

options.title: Choose another maximum
options.body: Select and document a different limit from supported prompt and runtime constraints before the feature first ships.

options.title: Consolidate before shipping
options.body: Use the broader PR as canonical only after it absorbs this hardening and resolves its symlink-compatibility difference.

recommendation.title: Standardize on 4 MiB
recommendation.body: Approve this threshold and require the broader input work to reuse the same constant and current-main symlink behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the unreleased feature and are the strongest available owner signal for deciding its initial shipped contract.
